'''Lycroa''', officially the '''Federal Republic of Lycroa''' is a country in [[Ayuma]] and [[Souther Ayuma|Souther Ayuma]] It lies north of the [[Escaran Channel]] . Its fifteenth constituent states have a total [[population]] of over 84 million in an area of 357,596 km2 (138,069 sq mi), making it the [[List of countries and dependencies by population|fifth most populous]] member state on the [[Ayuma|Ayuman]] cotenant. It borders [[Darewa]] to the north, [[Eldjo]], [[Praesyu]] and [[Ilicuhe]] to the east, [[Emara]], and [[Siana]] to the west. The nation's capital and most populous city is [[Junhui|Jungui]] and its main financial centre is [[Liambra]]; the largest urban area is the [[Kuya]].

[[Wikipedia:Human_settlement|Settlement]] in the territory of modern Lycroa began in the [[Wikipedia:Stone_Age|Stone age]], with various [[Wikipedia:Tribe|tribes]] inhabiting it from the [[Farones]] onward, chiefly the [[Nis-Breakers]]. Various [[Carth]] tribes have inhabited the southern and western parts of modern Lycroa since [[Ancient history]]. In 608, the [[Kingdom of Pyrelia]] controlled the bulk of the modern Lycroa . During the 14th century, Lycroa started to become the strongest military force in Ayuma, The Lycroan regions became the centre of the [[Social Reformation]]. Following the [[Seniaaii Revolution]] and the dissolution of the [[Wikipedia:Monarchy|Monarchy]] in 1539, the [[Lycroan Republic]] was formed in 1556.

The reorganisation of Lycroa into the a [[Wikipedia:Nation_state|modern nation-state]] commenced on 18 August 1616 with the [[Lycroan Federation]] establishing the highly [[Wikipedia:World_population|populous]] and [[Wikipedia:Industrialisation|industrialised]] west, which became the [[Lycroan Empire]] in 1632. After [[Great Imperial War|The Great Imperial War]] and the [[Lycroan Civil War]] of ___-___ , the Empire was replaced by the [[Kosuu Republic.]] The [[Socialists]] rise to power in 1683 led to the establishment of a [[Wikipedia:Guided_democracy|managed democracy]], [[Red War]], and the [[Treaty of Freedom|Treaty of Freedom.]] In 1696, after the war and a period of ____occupation, Lycroa was organised into two separate polities with [[Wikipedia:Sovereignty|limited sovereignty]]: the Federal Republic of Lycroa, or [[South Lycroa]], the [[North Lycroa|Lycroan State]], or [[North Lycroa]], and Lycroan Protectorate, or West Lycroa. It continued its de jure 3 Power status. The Federal Republic of Lycroa was a founding member of the [[Ayuman Non-Aligned]] moment, the [[Ayuman Economic Partnership]] , while the [[North Lycroa|Lycroan State]] was a [[Wikipedia:Fascism|Krunder]] [[Estijan Huan|Huan]] state and member of the [[Shamarin Pact]]. First [[Emara]] handed back the [[Lycroan Protectorate]] to the Federal Republic in 1722, After the fall of the [[Wikipedia:Fascism|Krunder]] led-government in [[North Lycroa]], [[Lycroan reunification]] saw the former North Lycroan states join the Federal Republic of Lycroa thorough 1738.

Lycroa is a [[Wikipedia:Developed_country |developed country]] with a strong economy; it has the [[List of countries and dependencies by population|largest economy in Europe by nominal GDP]]. As a major force in several industrial, [[Wikipedia:Science|scientific]] and [[Wikipedia:Technology|technological]] sectors, it is both the world's [[List of countries by exports|third-largest exporter]] and [[List of countries by imports|importer]]. It offers [[Wikipedia:Welfare_spending|social security]], a [[Wikipedia:Universal_health_care|universal health care system]], and tuition-free [[Wikipedia:Tertiary_education|university education]]. Widely considered a great power, Lycroa is part of multiple international organisations and forums. It has the fourth-highest number of [[Global Heritage Sites]]: 54, of which 51 are cultural.
